items.summary: Production Quiet Companion Desk migration and key typed flows are implemented; remaining user flows/accessibility/release are separate items.

11月8日r10已安装：B1历史核心补齐，正文搜索/多页续查、旧会话实际最近活动排序、准确分页末尾、预览与对话阅读锚点、独立历史读取错误、同请求去重和A→B→A迟到回包隔离。普通列表只解密标题/末条摘要，不创建明文正文索引。Python692及前端154项通过，7个亮暗/紧凑/错误与滚动夹具通过；实际构建/安装Gateway验证105段会话、400条加密消息八页与重启；实际安装窗口完成正文搜索→原会话预览→继续原会话→加载前文并保留位置。包28,962,452字节，SHA256 c492940c8e5090f080b95a1d3822c57beb59d0f5cad4fdbb874378f34e403994，未签名。Host仅有预期UNK→NSS三字节打包标记差异，其他字节一致，Gateway符合manifest。无外部模型请求或日常数据修改；未重测新的真实模型续聊回合。证据 outputs/history-core-20261108/VERIFICATION.md。下一批B5优先补用户可用的主动陪伴/后台回应及深度记忆整理，所需真实调试处置随能力补齐；B4正式内容服务与发布依赖仍单列。
Complete signing, updates, N-1 migration, rollback, SBOM, canary, target-hardware performance and Beta gates.
Project .venv imports fastapi successfully on 2026-09-09; use this environment instead of the historical system-Python failure.
Expose capability-based provider/model choices, existing credential migration and custom compatible endpoints without hardcoding DeepSeek Chat.

B3 r7 adds actionable Persona/Relationship domain governance with real audit/latency and native permission. Existing turn/HTTP/Memory bridges remain. F18/F30 complete worker attempts/failure coverage, remaining F20/F22, protected approvals, WorldOps governance and Host/WebView timing stay open.
Provision and benchmark a production vector backend; adapters and tests exist but deployment topology is environment-specific.
Calibrate extractor, recall, planner, surface, lifecycle, persona, affect and relationship thresholds on consented Beta traces.
Deploy content distribution/editorial services and author signed production content packs.
Corrected Affect/WorldOps and Relationship design/audit mapping; added standalone BYOK, Runtime, Gateway and unified dataflow entries. Not a full rereview of every PRD.
Implement the intentionally deferred Recall trace retention linkage with Module 08 forgetting/lifecycle policy.
Desktop perception, vision, voice and always-on visual presence remain outside the text-first release.

Managed scheduler wired at composition root with dynamic provider availability, leases, checkpoint replay, backoff, shutdown and queue diagnostics. Verified by focused/full tests and real deepseek-v4-flash smoke; see docs/MEMORY_BACKGROUND_INGESTION.md.

Committed event ingress preserves source/conversation/runtime-turn/correlation/owner identity. Atomic ingestion receipt and stable evidence/candidate IDs cover retry, cross-connection delivery, cancellation and source deletion; legacy REPL owner fallback corrected.

r6 managed post-commit index/projection/listener retry and r9 managed deterministic lifecycle periodic work are wired. Full external-owner fault/resource/forget-preemption matrix, full semantic consolidation and retention calibration remain open.
Coordinate active tasks and validate the uncommitted local candidate before authorized logical commits/push. Other worktrees do not contain these changes.

Finite user-authorized F01-F30 repair, not all complete. Preserve per-item source/test/install boundaries in outputs/desktop-functional-repair-20261015/PROGRESS.md; latest summary docs/DESKTOP_DELIVERY_STATUS.md.
F23 r2 installed WebView create/switch/app.restart sample passes. Complete failure/upgrade matrix, scoped-location and accessibility checks. Matching r4 sidecar is installed.

F24 NSIS AUMID and shortcut verified. First Setting ERROR_NOT_FOUND deadlock fixed; actual installed UI receives Windows submission receipt. Banner/background real-turn notification and MSI equivalent remain open. Evidence outputs/desktop-notifications-20261107/VERIFICATION.md.

Nov7 installed save/cancel and confirmed erasure recovery/app.restart passed with neighbour preservation. Nov8 actual Windows vault synthetic-owner deletion and neighbour preservation passed through the final frozen Gateway. Complete fault/path/permission/upgrade matrix remains open. Evidence outputs/memory-governance-20261108/VERIFICATION.md and outputs/desktop-install-20261106/VERIFICATION.md.

Nov8 r10 combined regression and unsigned installed candidate verified: Python692/frontend154,7history visual/scroll fixtures,actual build/installed Gateway and native UI. Source snapshot archived on explicit user request; portable summary docs/releases/2026-11-08-r10.md. Formal release and other feature gaps remain separate.

User authorization renewed; six overview/status docs patched with26exact reviewed block writes and read back: progress81/architecture180/navigation277/dataflow38/DesktopPRD136/Memory151. Original requirements/resources retained; local pending flags reconciled. Evidence outputs/client-status-sync-20261029/CLOUD_SYNC.md and cloud-readback-verification.json. Product repair/release gaps remain open.

Nov8 r6 closes checked review/exact audit atomicity and post-commit core; r9 closes A03 semantic MERGE, A04 heuristic returned-content bound and default deterministic lifecycle scheduling. Full A05 and external fault matrices remain open. See outputs/memory-effectiveness-20261108/VERIFICATION.md.
Measure optional memory provider paths, embedding, retries and background calls as well as coordinator calls; buffered client first delta is not provider TTFT.

r10 history core installed verified: full body search/retry and continuation; recency before pagination; exact last page; visible-message prepend anchors; duplicate/ABA/scope/cursor guards; independent history failures. Python692/frontend154/7visual fixtures, 105 owned conversations and400 encrypted messages, actual GUI search/continue/read earlier. No new live provider continuation round or fixed-snapshot pagination promise. See outputs/history-core-20261108/VERIFICATION.md.

r9 implements governed semantic MERGE with source/base checks, privacy-preserving fields and checked rollback; actual returned text is within its named heuristic budget, including zero/tiny limits. Installed real Gateway review enhances the canonical gist. See outputs/memory-effectiveness-20261108/VERIFICATION.md.

r9 wires managed hourly bounded least-recently-scored heat/expiry/tombstone maintenance with atomic checkpoint, persisted confirmed pause/resume and normal shutdown. Installed periodic tick and restart verified. No automatic semantic consolidation; full A05 remains open.

Nov8 r7 core delivered: real scoped Persona/Relationship controls, staged readable agreement confirmation/revocation, repair transitions, bounded proposal/contribution/audit views and native5minute exact-revision reject/rollback. Python654/frontend138/Host18+2ignored;8visual fixtures; build/installed API writes+restart and actual Host/WebView reads verified. Protected approvals/other domains/full fault matrix remain. See outputs/companion-controls-20261108/VERIFICATION.md.

r9 connects typed signed authored choice/task/personal timeline and actual actionable shared-memory review. QA pack signatures and real owner stores verified in build/installed Gateway; UI labels current local_split_development. New lantern source is reviewable, not officially published. Formal content distribution/editorial/server signing deployment and legacy completed-effect pending migration remain open.

Complete F18/F30 per-owner task/attempt/failure records and safe recovery plus required F20/F22 drilldown. New B1-B4 flows must already carry basic true timing/failure/audit evidence; B5 closes remaining coverage.

execution_policy.goal: Deliver usable main product flows before expanded release validation
execution_policy.priority_semantics: priority retains risk/release severity; execution_batch defines delivery order; aggregate rows do not duplicate child work
execution_policy.preemption: Actual inability to chat, privacy, identity or data-loss regressions preempt this order
execution_policy.user_override: Prioritize B3 then B4 then B2; B1 follows.
